trailhead.label: the bridge in Techendorf, the board’s start

cautions: About 150 m on the Weißensee road (B87) and 150 m on the Techendorfer Straße (L7) at the Kreuzwirt end, and about 200 m on the L7 (50 km/h) near Techendorf: keep your dog close on a short lead.
About 1 km of steeper, rougher track and path that OpenStreetMap grades as demanding mountain hiking (T3): sure-footed walking, no exposure.
Farm animals around the Tschabitscher farm: short lead.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
